title: Ordering Terms for Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
## 1. Who orders

1.1 A Real Estate Service Contracts plan is ordered by a licensed real estate agent for a client, or directly by the buyer or the seller of the property.

1.2 An order placed by an agent is accepted only when the ordering agent license number on the order matches the real estate license number on a real estate agent profile on file. This is checked against the system record of agent profiles before the order is placed; the license number on the order is the item matched.

1.3 Agents receive no compensation of any kind for ordering a plan.

## 2. Property facts and the entry gate

2.1 The property type, unit count and square footage on the order are taken from the ordering party's statement and must satisfy the entry gate of the plan ordered. These facts rest on what the ordering party states for the property address on the order, before the order is placed.

## 3. Listing orders with seller coverage

3.1 A listing order with seller coverage is placed only by or for the seller, only on a plan whose seller coverage is available, and only while the home is listed for sale.

3.2 Its customer is the seller. It starts in listing coverage on the order date, with a listing coverage end date equal to the order date plus the plan's seller coverage period in calendar days.

*Hypothetical illustration:* an order dated 10 March on a plan whose seller coverage period is 180 days has a listing coverage end date of 6 September.

## 4. Buyer-only orders

4.1 A buyer-only order is placed for the buyer once a purchase contract is signed. Its customer is the buyer, and it starts in awaiting closing with no coverage until closing.

4.2 The Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan is ordered only buyer-only, for a single-unit home whose certificate of occupancy is dated no more than the entry gate's day limit before the expected closing.

## 5. Plan changes before closing

5.1 *Retired clause — no longer in force:* "The plan ordered may be changed to another plan at any time before closing, and the invoice is then reissued at the new plan's premium." It is superseded by the current basis for reissued plan invoices: the plan ordered may still be changed to another plan at any time before closing, and the invoice is then reissued at the reissued plan premium of the current basis; only such a reissued invoice is priced this way.

## Order types at a glance

| | Listing with seller coverage | Buyer-only |
|---|---|---|
| Placed by or for | the seller | the buyer |
| When | while the home is listed for sale | once a purchase contract is signed |
| Customer on the contract at order | the seller | the buyer |
| Starting status | listing coverage, from the order date | awaiting closing, no coverage until closing |
| Plans | those whose seller coverage is available | all plans; the only type for Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year |

superseded_clauses: The plan ordered may be changed to another plan at any time before closing, and the invoice is then reissued at the new plan's premium.
